title: Search Before You Build
idiom: chiaroscuro woodcut, a lantern finding the part already made
hero_prompt: Chiaroscuro woodcut print in black, ochre and cream, hand-made on paper, flat and graphic with visible woodgrain and ink texture, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field: a woman carpenter in an apron holding up a lantern in a dim workshop, peering into a tall cabinet of many small plain wooden drawers with round wooden knobs and no label plates; one drawer is pulled open and inside it, lit by her lantern, lies the very wooden gear she was about to carve, while on the bench behind her a raw block of wood and a chisel wait untouched.
icon_prompt: Woodcut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on an ochre ground, no shading or gradients: a raised lantern beside an open drawer with a single gear inside it. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
